text:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: latency_slo_burn service=redwood-api region=us-east metric=p99 latency=3.18s threshold=2.2s severity=page
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-98231 created and routed to on-call
mia: acked, looking now. seeing p95 creeping too (~1.1s -> 1.9s)
alex: thanks, mia. any active rollout in us-east?
mia: checking deploys... nothing obvious in CI. no canary roll today.
simon: I'm pulling traces — I see a backlog on the embed-sidecar queue, sticky-queue depth up 4x
lina: @simon can you paste the slow span example?
simon: span: inference.encode -> wait(queued) -> server.decode, tail latency at worker-3. suspect batcher sidecar sticking on slow conn
mia: quick mitigation: shift a small % of traffic to eu-west routing policy, and bump concurrency on us-east pool by +1
alex: +1 on routing, triggered divert. also increasing batcher max_in_flight to 64 for the hot pool (kubectl patch deployment batcher --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"batcher","env":[{"name":"MAX_IN_FLIGHT","value":"64"}]}]}}}}')
simon: warming KV cache for hot keys: running curl to /internal/kv/warm?prefix=chat:topk (will take ~30s)
lina: monitoring client error rate — currently steady, no customer 5xx spike yet. if tail keeps climbing we should failover to smaller-gen model variant to reduce compute
mia: started a canary reroute to eu-west 5% -> 20%. watching p99 trend.
alex: also scaling up dedicated GPU pool in us-east (requested +2 instances)
simon: note: redis replica lagged earlier, caught up. eviction thrash could have amplified queueing — keeping an eye.
lina: customer impact check: CS reported no new tickets in last 15m, but a few SDK clients in one tenant saw slow responses in traces
mia: if stabilization in 10m, I'll hand off to next on-call. otherwise escalate to SRE rotation.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-98231 status=acknowledged assignee=mia
pagerduty: Reminder: escalate after 25 minutes if SLO burn persists
alex: p99 down to 2.6s after reroute & scaling. still above threshold but trending down.
simon: KV warm completed, sidecar queue depth back to baseline on two hosts.
mia: summary for handoff: PD-98231 — p99 latency spike from 3.18s -> mitigations: traffic partial reroute to eu-west, batcher concurrency bump, +2 GPUs requested, KV warm triggered. Customer impact: isolated tenant traces show slow calls, no broad 5xx. Current status: p99 2.3s trending to 2.0s. next on-call please watch paging for recurrence.
alex: noted. handing off to simon for monitoring window.
simon: taking watch. will post if tail reappears or client errors increase.
